meta.name: add-wechat
meta.description: Add WeChat (personal) channel integration via Tencent's official iLink Bot API. Uses long-polling and QR scan — no webhook, no ToS risk, no paid token.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 集成微信个人号消息收发，无需付费Token
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要将微信个人号接入自动化流程
copy.tagline_en: Integrate WeChat personal account messaging without paid tokens
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to connect WeChat personal account to automation workflows

howto.what: 装上后,你的智能体能通过微信个人号收发消息:微信好友发来的消息会交给智能体处理,回复也会自动发回微信。登录靠手机扫码,无需配置API密钥,也不用公网webhook。
howto.when: 当用户要求添加微信个人号通道、扫码登录微信,或把微信消息连接到智能体时触发。

say.text: 帮我把微信个人号接入智能体
say.note: 执行安装步骤并提示扫码登录。

say.text: 帮我扫码登录微信机器人
say.note: 重启服务并输出二维码,扫码后保存凭证。

say.text: 把微信消息接到默认智能体上
say.note: 运行 wire-dm 脚本完成绑定。

howto.what_en: After installation, the assistant can send and receive messages via a personal WeChat account. Contacts' messages are routed to the agent and replies go back through WeChat. Login is via QR scan; no API keys or webhook needed.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to add a personal WeChat channel, scan-login WeChat, or connect WeChat messages to the agent.

say_en.text: Add my personal WeChat to the agent
say_en.note: Runs install steps and shows QR for login.

say_en.text: Help me scan-login the WeChat bot
say_en.note: Restarts service, prints QR, saves auth after scan.

say_en.text: Connect WeChat messages to the default agent
say_en.note: Runs wire-dm to bind the group.
